file.description: File of the use, relative to the input (for bytecode, the source file the class names)

col.description: Column of the use itself, -1 where the frontend has no column

method.description: The enclosing method's full name, empty where the use sits outside any method

module.description: What the use belongs to: an npm package, a Python module, a Java class, a PHP class, a Ruby constant, a C header

path.description: What is used inside the module: an export, a member, a method, a macro, a field (empty for a use of the module itself)

kind.description: What the use is: call, new, jsx, arg, ref, decorator, extends, implements, tag, import, decltype, annotation, attribute, methodref, macro or type

via.description: How the module was found: binding, type, name or macro

resolvedMethod.description: The callee's full name when the frontend resolved one, else empty; its spelling is the frontend's, so do not parse it

builtin.description: True for the language's standard library

declaringModule.description: The class that declares a called method when it differs from the receiver's static type; Java source only

purl.description: The package URL of the distribution the module belongs to, when atom knows one; left out while empty

resolvedPath.description: C and C++ only: the file the include of the record's header resolved to; left out when the record's own file did not include the header itself

isSystem.description: C and C++ only: true for a system include (<...>); present only when true

CallSitesRecord.title: Call Sites Record
CallSitesRecord.description: One record per external use site of an imported module, class, function or header: where the use is, what is used and how the module was found. One entry of the callsites array of the callsites slice.
